mapper.sql: select shop_code, warecode, warename, parentcode, waretype, address, contactperson, contactphone, activeflag, remark, createtime from sdsshop.u_m_warehouse
mapper.insert: insert into sdsshop.u_m_warehouse( shop_code, warecode, warename, parentcode, waretype, address, contactperson, contactphone, activeflag, remark, createtime ) values( #{shopCode}, #{wareCode}, #{wareName}, #{parentCode}, #{wareType}, #{address}, #{contactPerson}, #{contactPhone}, #{activeFlag}, #{remark}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update sdsshop.u_m_warehouse set warename = #{wareName}, parentcode = #{parentCode}, waretype = #{wareType}, address = #{address}, contactperson = #{contactPerson}, contactphone = #{contactPhone}, activeflag = #{activeFlag}, remark = #{remark} where shop_code = #{shopCode} and warecode = #{wareCode}
